text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so this is first-class excavation! 
It's a feat on par with the Princess Power 
Shovel that appeared in PuriFy!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, splendid. I hereby confer upon you 
a fifth rank license in the Sei-chan House 
Style of Hoe Swinging.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, hang on!? Sky-san, stop making 
that master-like face and help out! Don't 
you have any farmer's pride!?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, this farm is getting livelier 
and livelier by the day.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Looks like everyone's got the event the 
chairwoman set up on their minds. I'm 
pretty excited for it myself.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I see. ...Or rather, CB, to think you do 
farm work too...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I wonder what kind of event it 
will really be! Lately, I've been dreaming 
about it constantly!”

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... The previous recital was amazing 
too, so I wonder how it'll turn out this 
time."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has been steadily deepening their 
knowledge of nutritional science, too... 
so things look like they'll reach a pretty 
high level on that front as well...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
An even better Bono-buono than back then, 
huh... I'm so excited~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Can't afford to slack off now. Not just 
with growing vegetables, but with cooking 
too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's try doing another taste 
test!
